valdas.at25: In 2002, he wins 4,000 litas on a Lithuanian quiz show and moves to England to coach.

elon.at25: In 1996, he is CTO of Zip2, co-founded with Kimbal. Compaq buys it in 1999.

mandela.at25: In 1944, while studying law at the University of the Witwatersrand, he co-founds the ANC Youth League.

trump.at25: En 1971, Donald Trump, diplômé de l'université de Pennsylvanie en 1968, devient président de Trump Management, la société immobilière de son père dans les quartiers périphériques de New York. Il s'installe à Manhattan et adopte le nom Trump Organization.

chesky.at25: In 2006, the RISD graduate designs toys and medical equipment in Los Angeles. Airbnb does not exist yet.

collison.at25: At 25, Patrick (2013) runs Stripe, valued at $1.75 billion in 2014; John (2015) is its president.

pope.at25: In 1981, the Augustinian friar studies theology in Chicago and takes solemn vows, a year before ordination.

jose.at25: In 1987, he joins Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory as an electrical engineer. NASA selects him only in 2004.

thatcher.at25: In 1950 and 1951, Margaret Roberts works as a chemist and runs for Parliament in Dartford, losing twice.

jensen.at25: In 1988, he is an LSI Logic engineer, studying at night at Stanford. He co-founds Nvidia in 1993.

rdj.at25: In 1990, he co-stars with Mel Gibson in Air America. Chaplin earns him an Oscar nomination in 1992.

disney.at25: In 1927, he and Ub Iwerks create Oswald the Lucky Rabbit for Universal at his Los Angeles studio.

ford.at25: Married to Clara Bryant in April 1888, he runs a lumber business on his father's former farmland.
